title: Paul McCartney live: Foxboro Stadium, Foxborough | 1990
content:
Paul McCartney performed at the Foxboro Stadium in Foxborough, Massachusetts, USA, on 24 July 1990.

It was the 100th date of the Paul McCartney World Tour, which lasted for 102 dates across 14 countries between September 1989 and July 1990, and the first of two nights in Foxborough.

McCartney’s band was Linda McCartney on vocals, keyboards, and percussion; Hamish Stuart on guitar, bass guitar, and vocals; Robbie McIntosh on guitar and vocals; Paul ‘Wix’ Wickens on keyboards and vocals; and Chris Whitten on drums and percussion.
